title: For Looks - Not for Taste
text:
I did this subscription for one month. I will admit, I'm a sucker for packaging and these pulled me in. The packaging lived up to the hype. I was a little disappointed that the labels do not come off the package easily, causing stickiness, and needing to do some detailing before I can reuse them.

The value for the half-price was great - $25 for six containers of candy. That being said, I don't think I would pay double at $50 for six containers of candy, so I canceled it. Additionally, I was disappointed that so many of the gummies tasted like plastic. There was only a couple that I was willing to eat more of. The rest were not good enough to justify the calories and sugar content. If I want a treat - I want something tasty and exciting. I would not recommend purchasing this. It’s very disappointing.
label: negative
